殺したい相手、いらっしゃいませんか？: Is there anyone you'd like killed?
……俺はこの基地の司令だぞ？<br>暗殺したい相手などいない。:
...I'm the commander of this base, you know?
I don't have anyone I want assassinated.
そうでしょうか？<br>立場があれば、邪魔も増えるものだと思うのですが。:
Is that so?
When you're in a position like that, I'd think the number of people getting in the way would increase.
でしょう？ そういった相手を殺してしまえば、<br>日常が少し豊かになりますよ？:
See? If you get rid of those kinds of people,
your everyday life would become a bit easier, wouldn't it?
暗殺で豊かになる日常など願い下げだ。<br>そもそも、暗殺者など募集していない。:
I have no interest in a life made easier by assassination.
And anyway, I'm not recruiting assassins.
アヤメは事務員として応募したんだ、<br>あくまでも事務員として採用させてもらう:
You applied as a clerk, Ayame,
and I'm hiring you only as a clerk.
アヤメが言ったように、まずは試用期間だ。<br>真っ当な事務員として働けるのか見:
As Ayame said, you'll start with a probationary period.
Prove you can work properly as a clerk.
……暗殺者と分かっている相手を、<br>基地から放り出すわけにもいかないしな。:
...You
can't exactly toss someone out of the base when you know they're an assassin.
ありがとうございます！<br>精一杯、働かせていただきますね。:
Thank you very much!
I'll do my very best.
重ねて言うが、<br>仕事内容は普通の事務員だからな。:
I'll say it again,
your duties are those of a normal clerk.
となると、お仕事の内容は……: So, then, the job duties are...
部屋の掃除、書類の整理、<br>資材の管理や、雑用をやってもらう。:
You'll be cleaning rooms, organizing paperwork,
managing supplies, and handling odd jobs.
どうしましょう。<br>少しも自信がありません……:
What should I do?
I have absolutely no confidence...
司令官様、<br>書類の整理が終わりました。:
Commander,
I have finished organizing the documents.
ほう。不安そうだったがなかなか早いな。<br>……ふむ、問題はなさそうだが。:
Oh. You looked uncertain earlier, but you're quite fast.
...Hm, there don't appear to be any problems.
それから、こちらも確認していただけますか？: Also, could you take a look at this?
ほとんどは私が見ても構わない書類でしたが、<br>機密情報がまぎれていたので、別:
Most of them were documents I could review myself,
but I separated out a few classified files that were mixed in.
……内容に機密事項がふくまれている、か。<br>こちらのミスだ。よく気づいたな。:
...The contents include classified information, do they?
That's our oversight. Good catch.
重要書類には特有の雰囲気がありますので。<br>見つけるのには慣れています。:
Important documents have a certain feel to them.
I'm used to spotting them.
どういう経緯で慣れたんだろうな。 <br>まぁ、書類整理は文句なしか。:
I wonder how you came by that skill.
Well, no complaints about the paperwork.
お褒めいただけてうれしいです。<br>前職の経験が役に立って、ほっとしています。:
I'm pleased to hear that.
I'm relieved my previous work experience is proving useful.
あー、詳しくは聞かないが、<br>ともかく期待できそうだ。:
Ah— I won't ask for details,
but in any case, you seem promising.
明日からしばらく、俺の補佐をしろ。<br>問題がなければ正式採用だ。:
Starting tomorrow, assist me for a while.
If there are no problems, you'll be officially hired.
アヤメ、仕事だ。この書類の清書を頼む。<br>急がなくていいが、確実にな。:
Ayame, I need you to do some work. Copy this document.
No rush, but make sure it's accurate.
もう終わったのか！？<br>これは……早い上に、達筆だな。:
You're already finished!?
This is... not only fast, but your handwriting is excellent.
ええ、書類の偽造は日常でしたから。<br>それに、書道にも親しんでおりますので。:
Yes—forging documents was part of my daily routine.
Besides, I'm also practiced in calligraphy.
日常的に偽造をするな。<br>ともかく助かった、いい仕事だ。:
Don't make it sound like you forged things daily.
In any case, that was a big help—good work.
アヤメ、仕事だ。<br>俺の礼服の洗濯をしておけ。:
Ayame, I've got a job for you.
Wash my dress uniform.
面倒だが、お偉いさんの視察があってな。<br>任せたぞ。:
It's a pain, but a VIP is coming to inspect.
I'm counting on you.
ご苦労。<br>問題なく終わったか？:
Good work.
Was everything finished without any problems?
はい。ただ、肩周りのサイズにズレがありましたので、<br>私のほうで調整いたしま:
Yes.
However, there was a discrepancy around the shoulders, so I adjusted it myself.
少し大きいとは思っていたが。<br>よく見ているな、アヤメ。:
I did think it was a little large.
You're very observant, Ayame.
潜入のための衣服の調達や、<br>サイズの調整をするのは日常でしたので。:
I regularly had to procure clothes for infiltrations
and alter sizes, so it was routine for me.
当たり前のように窃盗行為を自白するな。<br>今後は必要な装備があれば申請してく:
Don't just casually confess to stealing things.
From now on, request any equipment you need.
用意していただけるんですか？<br>とても助かります、ありがとうございます。:
You'll prepare them for me?
That would be a great help, thank you.
司令官として当然だ、そんなことで喜ぶな。: It's my duty as Commander. Don't get so pleased about it.
他にお仕事はありませんか？<br>司令官様のご命令でしたら、なんでもいたしますよ:
Is there anything else I can do?
If it's an order from the Commander, I'll do anything.
そうだな……。<br>この際だ、肩たたきでも頼むか。:
Let's see…
While we're at it, could you give me a shoulder massage?
ほう、なかなかいい感じだ。<br>経験があるのか？:
Oh, that's rather good.
Do you have experience?
職業柄、人の体の構造はよく分かっていますから。: Because of my line of work, I'm well acquainted with the structure of the human body.
だから事務員はそういう職業柄じゃないからな？: Still, being a clerk isn't that kind of job, you know?
……しかし正しい事務員をしていなかったわりに、<br>アヤメはなんでもできるな。:
…Still, despite not exactly being a proper clerk, Ayame
can do just about anything.
長らく１人で生きていましたので、<br>大抵のことはできるつもりです。: I've been living on my own for a long time, so I expect I can handle most things.
ほとんどは暗殺者としての経験が理由だと思うが……: I suppose most of that comes from your experience as an assassin…
ともかく、事務員としての仕事に文句はない。<br>そろそろ正式採用でもいいな。:
In any case, I have no complaints about your work as a clerk.
It's about time we made your position official.
あの……これだけでよろしいんですか？: Um… is this all I'm supposed to do?
大抵の雑用は頼んだつもりだが、<br>何か確認不足があるか？:
I thought I'd asked you to take care of most of the chores,
is there something I failed to mention?
本当に、誰も殺さなくていいのでしょうか？: Are you really saying I don't have to kill anyone?
必要ない。<br>こちらの求めている事務員は、殺しなどしない。:
No. It's unnecessary.
The kind of clerk we're looking for doesn't do any killing.
ですが、できるのであれば、<br>殺したほうがいいのでは……:
But if you can do it,
wouldn't it be better to just kill them…?
この基地で、<br>誰を殺す必要があるというんだ。:
Who on this base is
there a need to kill?
例えば、売店の店員さんとか、どうでしょう？<br>司令官様、殺したくありませんか:
For example, how about the shop clerk at the canteen?
Commander, don't you want to kill them?
なんで俺が店員を殺さなきゃならない！？: Why do I have to kill a shop clerk!?
以前、営業終了直前に来店した司令官様を、<br>閉店済みだと言い張って追い出した: Before, when the Commander came in just before closing, they insisted the shop was already closed and chased you out, didn't they?
……言われてみればそんなこともあったが、<br>どうしてアヤメが知っている？:
…Now that you mention it, that did happen,
but how do you know, Ayame?
司令官様のご指示で、基地の中を歩き回りましたから。<br>いろんなお話が聞けまし:
At your instruction, Commander, I walked all around the base.
I heard all sorts of stories.
他にも司令官様の挨拶を無視した兵士さん、<br>近くの街で肩がぶつかり、舌打ちを:
There were soldiers who ignored the Commander's greeting,
and a man in a nearby town who bumped into you and clicked his tongue…
こういった不愉快な要素を排除することができますよ？<br>私にお仕事として任せて:
I can remove these unpleasant elements, you know?
Would you let me handle it as part of my duties?
その程度のイライラで殺していたら<br>この場所は無人になるわ！:
If we killed people over every little irritation like that,
this place would be deserted!
そうおっしゃらずに、<br>もっと軽い気持ちで殺しましょう？:
Don't say that—
why not try killing with a lighter heart?
殺してしまえば、<br>２度と司令官様をイライラさせることはないんです。:
Once they're dead,
they'll never irritate the Commander again.
もうあの顔を見なくていいと思えば、<br>司令官様も穏やかな気持ちで眠れますよね:
If you never have to see that face again,
you'd be able to sleep peacefully, wouldn't you, Commander?
安眠のために人を殺すな！<br>ここはそこまで殺伐とした基地じゃない！:
Don't kill people just so you can sleep!
This isn't that cutthroat a base!
では私は、誰も殺さないでいいんですか……？: So... I really don't have to kill anyone...?
残念そうにするな。<br>これからもただの事務員として働けばいい。:
Don't look so disappointed.
From now on you can just keep working as an ordinary clerk.
ですが……では、そうです。<br>倉庫の兵士さんとか、殺しませんか？:
But... well then.
Shall we kill the soldiers in the warehouse?
倉庫の水漏れがあって、<br>臨時の部屋へ資材を移したんですよね？:
There was a leak in the warehouse,
and they moved the supplies into a temporary room, right?
それを利用して、水漏れで破損したと嘘をつき、<br>担当者が資材を横領している…:
Using that as cover, they'd lie that the supplies were damaged by the leak,
and the person in charge would be embezzling the materials... right?
今夜お会いしようと約束しておきましたので、<br>誰にも見られずに処分できますよ:
I've already arranged to meet him tonight,
so we can dispose of him without anyone seeing, you know?
うふふ、とってもゆるんだお顔でしたので、<br>きっと誰にも言わず、１人でいらっ:
Heh heh, he looked so relaxed,
he'll definitely come alone and tell no one.
……ああ、アヤメの有能さはよく分かった。<br>事務員としても、殺しのほうもな。:
...Ah. I see just how capable you are, Ayame.
Both as a clerk and when it comes to killing.
分かった、仕事を依頼しよう<br>本番の、だ。:
Alright. I'll give you a job—
the real thing.
